subject.title: fix(config): improve validation error messages with line numbers, bracket paths, and received values

question: Should this full diagnostic implementation become the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/104854, or should the narrower formatter from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104935 land first while source-location and value hints are redesigned?
rationale: Both PRs are proof-positive and overlap on bracket formatting, while this PR additionally introduces a substantial JSON5 navigation and value-disclosure boundary that requires config-area ownership rather than automatic conflict repair.

options.title: Adopt this full fix after repair
options.body: Keep this PR canonical, correct effective-value lookup and redaction coverage, resolve main conflicts, and close the narrower overlapping PR after validation.

options.title: Land bracket formatting only
options.body: Use the narrower PR for the low-risk display improvement and redesign line/value diagnostics separately around the canonical config parser and sensitivity contract.

options.title: Pause both implementations
options.body: Close neither PR until a config owner defines a shared source-location representation that avoids parallel JSON5 grammar handling.

recommendation.title: Adopt this full fix after repair
recommendation.body: Keep this PR canonical, correct effective-value lookup and redaction coverage, resolve main conflicts, and close the narrower overlapping PR after validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config validation and IO history most directly covers the authored-versus-resolved snapshot boundary involved in the decision.
